name: University of Illinois College of Medicine Peoria Research Day 2027
organizer: University of Illinois College of Medicine Peoria
venue: University of Illinois College of Medicine Peoria campus
description: Research Day is the annual showcase of the research enterprise on the Peoria regional campus of the University of Illinois College of Medicine, open to faculty, students, residents, and fellows, with abstract submission and poster and oral presentations, limited to two first author submissions per person. The 2027 edition is scheduled for May 5, 2027, though 2027 abstract and poster printing deadlines had not been published as of September 2026.
